jobs.title: Clinical Supervisor - Board-Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA)
jobs.description:
**Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) Clinical Supervisor (Secondary/Transition Program: Ages 12 – 21\)**

**Pay:** $75,000\.00 \- $86,700\.00 per year

**Location:** Arvada, CO

**Schedule:** Full\-Time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

**Up to 7 Weeks Paid Time Off A Year:** Paid Holidays (7 Days), Sick Leave (48 hours per year), PTO (40 hours per year) **PLUS** Paid Center Closures (5 weeks a year)!

**About Us** 

**Evoke Behavioral Health** is a**\*\_**locally owne\**\_d* organization that provides specialized educational and therapeutic services to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), and co\-occurring diagnoses. In 2025, we opened the doors to our newly renovated, state\-of\-the\-art facility in Arvada, CO, complete with two outdoor playgrounds, a full gym, and an advanced sensory room, all designed to enhance client care and staff experience.

Our interdisciplinary team includes BCBAs, LCSWs, Special Education Teachers, RBTs, Educational Assistants, Mental Health Assistants and a large number of graduate students working across our departments. In addition to our comprehensive clinical team, we have on\-site administrative, human resources, nurse and maintenance support to ensure a safe and effective work environment.

**Position Overview** 

The BCBA Clinical Supervisor is responsible for the clinical case management of students in **Evoke’s Secondary/Transition Program**. This role leads the assessment and development of individualized treatment plans, provides supervision and support to Behavior Technicians and Specialists, and ensures data\-driven decision\-making to guide client progress. The Clinical Supervisor also partners closely with families and interdisciplinary teams to promote consistent, **high\-quality care** in alignment with BACB ethical standards and organizational values.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

* Conduct comprehensive assessments and develop individualized treatment plans
* Maintain a clinical caseload overseeing 800 – 1,000 RBT hours a month.
* Supervise and train RBTs, Behavior Specialists, and BCBA trainees
* Provide parent/caregiver training and support
* Participate in and occasionally lead team and clinical meetings
* Ensure documentation is timely and accurate (e.g., session notes, progress reports, incident documentation)
* Implement and support Safety Care protocols as needed
* Provide in\-the\-moment clinical support and crisis management
* Assist with Secondary Program, as needed.
* Other relevant duties assigned by your supervisor.

**Required Qualifications:** 

* Active BCBA certification in good standing
* Master’s degree in ABA, Psychology, Special Education, or a related field
* Experience training and supervising behavior technicians
* Experience working with children on the autism spectrum and/or with developmental disabilities
* Strong skills in behavior plan development, assessment, and data analysis
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to pass state and federal background checks
* Current CPR/First Aid certification, must obtain within 30 days of employment.
* Physically able to implement Safety Care protocols, including running, kneeling, lifting up to 40 lbs, pivoting, and transitioning from kneeling/seated to standing repeatedly

**Preferred Qualifications** 

* 2\+ years of experience as a BCBA
* Experience with children ages 12\-21
* Experience in treating high\-intensity behaviors
* Experience with co\-occurring diagnoses
* Experience working on an interdisciplinary team
* Familiarity with CentralReach

**Benefits** 

* Paid Time Off and Sick Leave
* Paid holidays!
* Paid Center closures, 5 weeks a year! : 1 week in Spring, 1 week in Summer, 1 week for Thanksgiving and up to 2 weeks in Winter (Christmas/New Year's)!
* Company\-sponsored medical (Anthem), dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with up to a 3% company match.
* CEU and continuing education opportunities (internal and external).
* Health Savings Account (with eligible plan).

Why Join Us?

* Brand new, thoughtfully renovated facility with cutting\-edge resources
* Collaborative, mission\-driven team environment
* Strong administrative and clinical support
* Opportunities for professional growth and leadership

Evoke Behavioral Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or veteran status.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position or participate in the hiring process, please contact us at B.fix@evokebehavioralhealth.com.

Job Type: Full\-time, Exempt (Salary\-based position)

Ability to Commute:

* Arvada, CO 80003 (Required)

Work Location: In person

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $86,700\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* In 2 \- 4 sentences, please tell us why you are interested in this position.
* How many years of relevant (ABA, Child Care, Special Education, Disability Support) experience do you have?

Education:

* Master's (Required)

License/Certification:

* Board Certified Behavior Analyst Certification (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Arvada, CO 80003 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Licensed Therapists & Behavioral Health Specialists - Remote
jobs.description:
Licensed Therapy Providers (Remote – Hiring Across Multiple States)

Help Us Build the Future of Integrated Mental Health Care

Anywhere Clinic is growing, and we're building something we've wanted to create for a long time \- a dedicated virtual Therapy Department.

Every day, our psychiatric providers receive requests from patients looking for therapy. Until now, we've had to tell them we simply don't have therapists available. We're changing that.

We're looking for compassionate, skilled therapy providers who are passionate about helping people heal and excited to be part of a collaborative, patient\-centered team. Whether you're an experienced licensed therapist or a specialist in a unique area of mental health and wellness, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Anywhere Clinic:**

Anywhere Clinic is an integrative telehealth mental health practice providing compassionate, evidence\-based psychiatric care across 40\+ states. Our mission is simple:

**To improve the human experience through accessible, high\-quality mental health care.**

We believe the best outcomes happen when patients have access to coordinated, collaborative care. By bringing together psychiatry, therapy, and wellness services, we're creating a model that supports meaningful, long\-term healing \- not just symptom management.

**A Different Approach to Mental Health Care:**

We know that some therapists hesitate to work alongside psychiatry because they've experienced models where medication is viewed as the only solution. That's not who we are.

At Anywhere Clinic, we believe exceptional mental health care goes beyond treating symptoms. Our providers take an individualized, thoughtful approach that seeks to understand the whole person and the underlying factors contributing to their challenges. Medication can be an important part of treatment, but it is only one piece of a comprehensive care plan.

We believe that when therapy, lifestyle, wellness, and psychiatry work together, patients achieve the best long\-term outcomes. Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, compassion, and respect for every discipline involved in the healing journey.

**Who We're Looking For:**

We welcome applications from licensed therapists and experienced specialists, including:

* Licensed Clinical Social Workers (LCSW)
* Licensed Marriage \& Family Therapists (LMFT)
* Licensed Professional Counselors (LPC/LPCC)
* Licensed Mental Health Counselors (LMHC)
* Psychologists (PhD/PsyD)
* Child \& Family Therapists
* Trauma \& PTSD Specialists (including EMDR)
* Addiction \& Recovery Specialists
* Couples \& Relationship Therapists
* Sex \& Intimacy Therapists
* Group Therapy Facilitators
* Grief Therapists
* End\-of\-Life Doulas
* Wellness and Mindset Coaches with relevant credentials and experience

If your specialty isn't listed but aligns with our mission, we'd still love to hear from you.

**What You'll Do:**

* Provide virtual therapy services to patients in your licensed state(s).
* Conduct comprehensive intake assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.
* Deliver evidence\-based, patient\-centered therapeutic care.
* Collaborate closely with psychiatrists, psychiatric nurse practitioners, and physician assistants to ensure continuity of care.
* Maintain accurate clinical documentation in accordance with HIPAA and professional standards.
* Contribute to the continued growth and development of our Therapy Department.
* Help patients achieve meaningful, lasting improvements in their mental health and wellbeing.

**Why Join Anywhere Clinic?**

✔ Fully remote position

✔ Flexible scheduling—you choose your availability

✔ We build your patient caseload

✔ Dedicated administrative and patient support teams

✔ No marketing or business development required

✔ Collaborative, multidisciplinary care model

✔ Opportunity to help shape a growing therapy department

✔ Work alongside an experienced psychiatric team that values therapy as an essential part of treatment

✔ Make a genuine difference in people's lives every day

**What We're Looking For:**

Our ideal providers are:

* Compassionate and patient\-centered
* Excellent communicators
* Collaborative and team\-oriented
* Passionate about holistic, evidence\-based mental health care
* Comfortable working remotely
* Adaptable, proactive, and growth\-minded
* Committed to delivering exceptional patient care

We are hiring providers across multiple states. Candidates licensed in more than one state are especially encouraged to apply, although multi\-state licensure is not required.

Priority States

We're currently experiencing particularly high demand in:

* Nevada
* California
* New York
* Arizona
* Colorado
* Florida
* Idaho
* Utah
* Texas
* Washington
* Oregon
* New Mexico

Providers licensed in additional states are also encouraged to apply as we continue expanding nationwide.

**Compensation:**

**$40–$100\+ per hour**

Compensation varies based on licensure, specialty, insurance credentialing, experience, and the services provided.

Job Details

**Position Type:** Contract / Part\-Time

**Location:** Fully Remote

**Schedule:** Flexible

**Our Core Values:**

At Anywhere Clinic, we hire people who share our values:

* Put People First
* Practice Intellectual Honesty
* Bias Toward Action
* Have a Growth Mindset
* Cultivate Wholeness \& Wellness

If these values resonate with you, we'd love to meet you.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about helping people heal and want to be part of a collaborative team that's redefining mental health care, we'd love to hear from you.

Visit **AnywhereClinic.com** to learn more about our mission and apply today.

Pay: $50\.00 \- $85\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
